Subject: Lead huddle: sales pulse & customer briefs — prep for leadership readout

Team —

Putting together a short readout for the leadership huddle next Friday (May 6). Goals: a concise sales pulse, a consolidated forecast delta vs. last quarter, and one-slide account briefs for the top 6 deals that need action. High-level asks: 

- Marissa: can you produce 1-slide briefs for DataWave, AcmeCloud, Nimbus with current ARR, close plan, and two risk flags each? Prefer the short one-pagers in PDF.
- Tessa: please draft the leadership slide with the 3-line narrative (health, runway, blocker) + a table with week-by-week coverage.
- Aditya: I need any leadership asks (credits, escalations, SLA exceptions) flagged separately.

I've attached an initial customer-digests.xlsx and deck-outline-v2.pptx — use as starting point.

Timeline: please drop drafts into the shared folder by EOD Thu (4/22) so I can consolidate before the field review on Fri.

Thanks — keep it crisp.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Sr. Sales Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Lead huddle: sales pulse & customer briefs — prep for leadership readout

Sounds good — I'll take the leadership slide. Quick notes inline: 

> - 3-line narrative (health, runway, blocker)
> - table with week-by-week coverage

Proposed additions: add a single "confidence" column (low/med/high) and a one-line mitigation for each low confidence account. I can draft the slide and a short speaker note for leadership (1 paragraph).

I'll pull last quarter's cadence metrics and include trend arrows. Filing a quick question: do we want to call out quota attainment by segment (PLG vs Enterprise) or keep it pure enterprise? I recommend enterprise-only for this readout.

I'll upload a first pass by Thu morning.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Head of Field Sales | Redwood Inference

Attaching account one-pagers (acct-summaries.pdf). Highlights for the readout: 

- DataWave (Elaine Torres): $1.2M ARR, contracting phase. Current close plan: pilot sign-off by 5/12, exec sponsor confirmation by 5/3. Risks: procurement delay (SOC2 evidence requested), and price pushback on high concurrency config. Elaine is open to a longer pilot window in exchange for an SOW addendum.

- AcmeCloud: $750k ARR, late-stage (verbal LOI). Close plan: legal signatures expected 5/2. Risks: cloud provider integration timeline (3rd party) — engineering engagement needed this week.

- Nimbus Analytics: $420k ARR, mid-stage. Close plan: pricing negotiation ongoing, finance needs clear TCO. Risk: procurement prefers annual billing only.

I also included two smaller deals to keep in the "monitor" bucket. HubSpot ref: HubSpot-67890 for DataWave.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: acct-summaries.pdf

Subject: Consolidated forecast + mutual action items (readout-ready)

Thanks for the one-pagers — I've consolidated the numbers and flattened the runway into the attached forecast-consolidation.csv and a short mutual-action-plan.docx. Summary: 

- Quarter delta: +$1.37M booked ARR (net of churn) vs. plan; coverage gap remains ~$600k to target.
- DataWave (DW-2027-31): moved from negotiate -> contracting. Proposed leadership ask: approve a 30-day technical extension + SOC2 evidence share to remove procurement blocker.
- AcmeCloud: in legal — no leadership ask required unless signatures slip past 5/5.
- Nimbus: pricing concession requested; recommend a $25k one-time discount tied to 12-month prepay.

Action items (owner, due):
- Marissa: finalize exec sponsor note to Elaine (due 5/3) — include SOC2 checklist and proposed pilot SOW.
- Tessa: finalize leadership slide and confidence table (due 5/4).
- Aditya: prepare a short memo on the proposed DW extension and SLA check (due 5/4).

I'll upload the consolidated deck to the share and create a short slide pack for the leadership huddle.

Thanks — Soojin
